text.text: The PlayStation Vita was released in 2011 as Sony's successor to the PlayStation Portable. It featured dual analog sticks, a touchscreen, rear touch panel, cameras, and support for physical Vita game cards. The system supported downloadable games, PlayStation classics, and remote features with PlayStation 4. Its library included titles such as Uncharted: Golden Abyss, Persona 4 Golden, Tearaway, Gravity Rush, and Killzone: Mercenary. The Vita remained in production until 2019 and developed a strong following for its hardware and independent game support.
